decisions.signer: The 5chan account's built-in ETH key (same derivation as the default author.wallets.eth) signs ballots silently; no browser wallet for voting. The Pass must be held by that address, so the purchase flow must tell buyers to back up their account (developer decision 2026-09-23).
decisions.scope: All three phases: read tally, cast votes, republish + homepage winner
decisions.network: Contests derive from the published lists manifest at runtime. Testnet contests (any bucketChainId other than Ethereum mainnet) show votes but keep the listed order and do not pick homepage winners; the mainnet manifest flips this automatically. The production 5chan Pass will live on Ethereum mainnet, priced in USD via Chainlink ETH/USD.
decisions.republishing: 5chan persists vote intent per voting wallet and contest and re-signs silently on start, refocus, and hourly once half the expiry window has passed; pubsub-voting supplies the cadence.
decisions.submission: Boards are submitted in-app by voting for them; tally rows missing from the lists file render as nominations. Upvote-only by design.

verified_facts: @bitsocial/pubsub-voting@0.6.1 is the latest npm release; 0.6.0 moves the signer from PubsubVoter to each ballot, renames publishing state succeeded to published, and exposes local/peer verification evidence, while 0.6.1 signs seeder provider announcements
lists/5chan-directory-criteria.jsonc is live and byte-identical to the vendored fallback: 64 valid unique contests, 1:1 with the 64 default directory codes, no per-contest overrides
bitsocial-seeder v0.10.5 uses pubsub-voting 0.6.1 and seeds that exact manifest URL by default
5chan Pass testnet criteria now use the erc5192-min-balance soulbound gate on Base Sepolia at 0xA8e0155E0e7d014EAF3917982db6a9A4dF98C852
5chan and bitsocial-react-hooks resolve pkc-js 0.0.85; F002 exercised its browser heliaNode path successfully before app integration

Rinse12/pubsub-voting-website and bso-board-vote.netlify.app use the same one-node architecture through pkc.clients.libp2pJsClients[key].heliaNode; the reference app snapshot inspected on 2026-08-15 pinned pubsub-voting 0.4.0 and pkc-js 0.0.76
better-sqlite3 already arrives via pkc-js, so pubsub-voting adds no new native dependency
pubsub-voting wants viem 2.54.0; the project resolution dedupes pubsub-voting, bitsocial-react-hooks, and bso-resolver onto viem 2.55.8

https://base-sepolia.drpc.org serves current ERC-5192 checks and eth_call at 1,296,000 blocks deep (the full 30-day expiry window); the official standard and preconf endpoints were temporarily unhealthy on 2026-08-21 and remain fallbacks
All candidate boards in the vendored directory lists carry both a .bso name and a publicKey, which is what a ballot requires
Criteria is upvote-only (voteSchema min=1 max=1) and maxVotesPerAddress=1, so the existing -1 button cannot be represented
Testnet cadence: 1800-block buckets (1h on Base Sepolia) x 720 buckets = 30 day expiry; republishIntervalBuckets = 360 buckets = ~15 days

pubsub-voting Contest.on has no unsubscribe API and createContest returns one cached Contest per topic, so React consumers need one stable fan-out adapter instead of attaching callbacks on every mount

items.notes: The hook refreshes the canonical manifest through useSyncExternalStore, keeps an equivalent vendored/live manifest on the same contest object, joins only the requested directory, and stops the topic when its last subscriber unmounts. Ready state retains the last tally while surfacing transient RPC or resolver errors.
